mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever found yourself pulled in a hundred different directions—fascinated by so many things, you’re not sure which one to choose? If that sounds familiar, you’re not alone. Imagine living in a world overflowing with possibilities, where curiosity isn’t something to tame but something to celebrate. That’s exactly the spirit you'll find in Refuse to Choose!, woven together by Barbara Sher’s compassionate insight. Together, we’ll explore what it means to be a “Scanner”—someone who simply can’t settle for just one passion or path. Instead of being boxed in by the idea that you have to pick just one thing and stick with it, what if you could see your endless curiosity as a gift? On this journey, you’ll discover practical ways to organize and prioritize all those interests swirling around in your mind. We’ll look at strategies to help you turn that vibrant mix of talents and hobbies into a life that feels both meaningful and deeply satisfying. So, get ready to open yourself up to new possibilities. Together, we’ll learn how embracing every part of who you are can lead to a dynamic, empowered, and truly fulfilling path forward.
